# Agent API Documentation

## Overview

This documentation covers the complete Agent API — a system for autonomous software development task execution, orchestration, and monitoring. The API is organized into modules spanning authentication, dashboard UI, task execution, AI agent pipelines, database access, and background daemon processes. Use the index below to navigate to the module most relevant to your needs.

---
